scope: Ninth noncanonical/unapplied proposal. Registration producer only: immutable guarded-finish receipt, one-unit clean-plus-exact-queue settlement or two-unit no-summary quarantine. Rescan/Apply and source-bound admission/queue/worker capacity hooks remain open.
finish: Preserve the complete original actor/receipt/state/outcome checks and reply. Add control/capacity lock before lease-row locking, then record the private registration receipt after completed lease update in the same transaction. Receipt refusal rolls back finish. Untracked or non-register operations gain no fabricated receipt or settlement.
source_proof: Derive actor/student/attempt/document/object/version/path/content/review identity from the immutable upload binding and registered attempt. Require actual persisted scan outcome, source identity, completed operation timestamp and exact counted queued job; not merely another matching job. Store metadata only, no raw scan ID, provider payload, text, names or private admission capability.
units: Clean-plus-exact-queue frees only its producer unit. Confirmed infection with rejected/archived source and clean_result false frees both units only if no summary was bound, claimed or otherwise queued. A confirmed summary and clean producer can settle in either order, exactly once each. Rescan/Apply and active/held/uncertain outcomes remain counted.
queue_protection: Serialize document-summary INSERT with the completion mutex so quarantine and queue insertion cannot race past each other. Check current actor/student/document authority before consulting private quarantine receipts; use the same safe refusal for unauthorized/quarantined requests. Retain registered queue source identity before worker binding while allowing normal claim/completion. This narrow gate does not replace the remaining general source-bound enqueue/reservation hooks or legacy-writer review.
ownership_and_grants: Existing finish keeps its coherent admission/control owner, which can differ from migration executor. Only that trusted SQL role receives execute on the private completion lock and registration recorder; recorder is a fixed-path definer returning void. New receipt/settlement tables remain private RLS, and all new helpers remain unavailable to anon/authenticated/service_role. No existing ownership transfer or new user-facing Owner/admin rights.
existing_reads: Preserve exact existing upload-attempt SELECT roles and the two scoped/service read policies; ordinary INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE and column mutation privileges still refuse. No permissions are repaired or expanded by preflight.
pause: Already-admitted work can finish/settle while paused; fresh admission is still blocked. Common control/capacity fence precedes finish lease locks. Quarantine queue races are tested in both transaction orders.
retention: Completion/settlement receipts and source references are permanent and RESTRICT-linked. No expiry, deletion, reset, retention duration, provider cancellation or ordinary held-work release.
required_next: Prepare exact source-bound rescan and Apply completion proof; do not settle actor-only leases from typed status.
